title: Owner password check: wrong guesses are counted before they are checked
text: When an owner confirms adding a team login, changing its powers, or sharing their personal papers, they re-type their password. The limit of 5 wrong tries is now counted before each password is checked, in the same shared counter as the team-login sign-in, so a burst of guesses at the same moment can no longer slip past it. Nothing changes on screen for an owner typing the right password.
